basic_details.job_title: DPA Chief Engineer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

age_limit.age_details: Maximum 45 years for Direct Recruitment; not applicable in case of absorption/deputation (as on 1 April 2027)

qualification.education_qualification: A degree or equivalent in Civil Engg. from a recognized university/institution; for absorption, officers in the scale of pay of Rs.80000-220000/- with three years regular service in the grade in the Civil Engineering Department of a Major Port Trust
qualification.details: Qualification: A degree or equivalent in Civil Engg. from a recognized university/institution; Absorption through composite method: officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs.80000-220000/- with three years regular service in the grade in the Civil Engineering Department of a Major Port Trust Experience: Three years regular service in the grade (Rs.80000-220000/-) in the Civil Engineering Department of a Major Port Trust; the 17 years' experience prescribed for direct recruitment does not apply to absorption Age limit: Maximum 45 years for Direct Recruitment; not applicable in case of absorption/deputation (as on 1 April 2027) | Other conditions: | Open to eligible officers of Major Port Authorities by absorption through composite method Crucial date for determining eligibility is 01/04/2027 | Desirable: | Experience preferably of Port and Marine Structure (in the direct recruitment qualification)

salary_details.pay_scale: Rs.1,00,000-2,60,000 (Pre-Revised Rs.18500-23900); Rs.1,20,000-2,80,000 after three years' regular service

how_to_apply: Register and apply on the Online Application Portal of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways (http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in) on or before 16/12/2026.
No application other than through OAP shall be accepted.
Affix a recent passport size photograph on the right hand corner of the printout of the filled-in application.
Attach self-attested copies of educational, experience and age certificates and the listed documents.
Send the hard copy through proper channel to The Secretary, Deendayal Port Authority, Gandhidham, to reach on or before 31/12/2026.
important_instructions: Documents relating to any Major/Minor penalty in the last 10 years may also be sent with the application Incomplete, late or not-through-proper-channel applications are liable to be rejected Management reserves the right to make changes or withdraw the vacancy circular without assigning any reason

content_sections.heading: DPA Chief Engineer Recruitment 2026 - Overview
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.deendayal_port_authority_dpa_gandhidham_: Rs.1,00,000-2,60,000 (Pre-Revised Rs.18500-23900); Rs.1,20,000-2,80,000 after three years' regular service

A degree or equivalent in Civil Engg. from a recognized university/institution; for absorption, officers in the scale of pay of Rs.80000-220000/- with three years regular service in the grade in the Civil Engineering Department of a Major Port Trust
Maximum 45 years for Direct Recruitment; not applicable in case of absorption/deputation (as on 1 April 2027)

content_sections.heading: DPA Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. GA/PS/2143/CE/2026/3608 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DPA notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: A degree or equivalent in Civil Engg. from a recognized university/institution; Absorption through composite method: officers holding posts in the scale of pay of Rs.80000-220000/- with three years regular service in the grade in the Civil Engineering Department of a Major Port Trust Experience: Three years regular service in the grade (Rs.80000-220000/-) in the Civil Engineering Department of a Major Port Trust; the 17 years' experience prescribed for direct recruitment does not apply to absorption Age limit: Maximum 45 years for Direct Recruitment; not applicable in case of absorption/deputation (as on 1 April 2027) Other conditions: Open to eligible officers of Major Port Authorities by absorption through composite method Crucial date for determining eligibility is 01/04/2027 Desirable: Experience preferably of Port and Marine Structure (in the direct recruitment qualification)

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DPA Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications other than through the Online Application Portal shall not be accepted Advance copy holders whose application is not received through proper channel by 31/12/2026 will not be considered

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Initial appointment to the HoD post in the scale of Rs.1,00,000-2,60,000 Elevation to Rs.1,20,000-2,80,000 after three years' regular service, subject to Ministry's conditions Period of probation: NA Withdrawal after selection by Service Selection Committee liable for debarment from HoD level posts in all Major Ports for two years

rows.event: Last date for online application on MoPSW Online Application Portal
Last date for receipt of hard copy of application through proper channel

content_sections.heading: How Will DPA Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Selection by merit, with benchmark in overall grading in the Annual Confidential Reports not below "Very good" Selection by the Service Selection Committee Selection is by merit; ACR overall grading benchmark not below "Very good"

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Attested copies of APARs/ACRs for the last 5 years, attested on each page by an officer not below Dy. HoD rank Attested copies of certificates and self-attested educational/experience/age certificates No-objection certificate of respective port Undertaking not to withdraw candidature, if selected Certificate from Head of Office (Annexure-II) Vigilance/Administrative clearance from the concerned port (Annexure-III)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DPA Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Register and apply on the Online Application Portal of the Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways (http://onlinevacancy.shipmin.nic.in) on or before 16/12/2026. No application other than through OAP shall be accepted. Affix a recent passport size photograph on the right hand corner of the printout of the filled-in application. Attach self-attested copies of educational, experience and age certificates and the listed documents. Send the hard copy through proper channel to The Secretary, Deendayal Port Authority, Gandhidham, to reach on or before 31/12/2026.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Documents relating to any Major/Minor penalty in the last 10 years may also be sent with the application Incomplete, late or not-through-proper-channel applications are liable to be rejected Management reserves the right to make changes or withdraw the vacancy circular without assigning any reason

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Chief Engineer.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DPA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 16 December 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 45 years for Direct Recruitment; not applicable in case of absorption/deputation (as on 1 April 2027).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Rs.1,00,000-2,60,000 (Pre-Revised Rs.18500-23900); Rs.1,20,000-2,80,000 after three years' regular service.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: A degree or equivalent in Civil Engg. from a recognized university/institution; for absorption, officers in the scale of pay of Rs.80000-220000/- with three years regular service in the grade in the Civil Engineering Department of a Major Port Trust.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Open to eligible officers of Major Port Authorities by absorption through composite method. Crucial date for determining eligibility is 01/04/2027.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications other than through the Online Application Portal shall not be accepted. Advance copy holders whose application is not received through proper channel by 31/12/2026 will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Selection by merit, with benchmark in overall grading in the Annual Confidential Reports not below "Very good". Selection by the Service Selection Committee. Selection is by merit; ACR overall grading benchmark not below "Very good".

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Initial appointment to the HoD post in the scale of Rs.1,00,000-2,60,000. Elevation to Rs.1,20,000-2,80,000 after three years' regular service, subject to Ministry's conditions. Period of probation: NA.
